infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ambient Care listens for falls, distress, and unusual silence to keep your loved one safe. Audio is analyzed on the device and is not recorded or stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used briefly to scan a medicine bottle so we can confirm it matches your medication list. No photos are saved.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech is used on the device to understand simple spoken requests like asking for your medicine.
